root_cause: On the clean Windows runner, the first flutter --version --machine invocation emitted tool bootstrap text around its JSON object. The gate attempted to parse the complete captured stream as JSON and failed before either revision suite ran.

repair.implementation: Parse only the bounded JSON object in the captured machine-version stream, then require all four version identity properties before running the unchanged baseline/candidate suites.
repair.rollback: Revert this repair commit; do not bypass Flutter tool identity capture or any quality ratchet.
